title: Grateful Dead Live at Milwaukee Performing Arts Center on 1972-10-23

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording but showcases a monster 28‑minute Dark Star in an intimate, talk‑heavy set.
ai_review.review: The tape suffers from very muddy, low‑fidelity sound with little instrument separation, making it hard to listen to for most of the show. However, Deadheads who love deep explorations will appreciate the extended 28‑minute Dark Star, which shines despite the audio flaws and the long, conversation‑filled performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews range from high praise for the Dark Star to strong criticism of the sound quality; the average star rating is ~3.2, and the standout jam nudges the overall assessment slightly higher.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very muddy with little instrument separation, frequent fades, and generally rough sound; some listeners note a ghostly, haunting character but it remains hard to handle.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long (≈4 hours) intimate show with extensive band‑to‑audience banter; the performance is dominated by an extended Dark Star and deep improvisation.
